day_shape: 97 items: State Department unveils Operation Economic Outcast sanctions on 17 shadow-fleet vessels, Trump rules out pre-midterms strike on Iran citing 'productive' talks, Pezeshkian meets Putin and Aliyev at Turkmenistan non-aligned summit, heavy Khamenei policing-week messaging cycle.

threads.label: Operation Economic Outcast shadow-fleet sanctions
threads.summary: The US State Department and Treasury announced sanctions on 17 vessels and their owners under Operation Economic Outcast, targeting Iran's shadow shipping network. State said the action aims to sever Iran's economic lifelines and protect freedom of navigation.

threads.label: Trump rules out pre-midterms Iran strike
threads.summary: Trump said the US would not attack Iran before the 3 November midterm elections and that 'productive' talks were underway, after reports of US preparations for large-scale strikes. IDF Chief Eyal Zamir reportedly warned that renewed joint US-Israeli attacks on Iran could postpone upcoming elections, per N12.

threads.label: Pezeshkian at Turkmenistan non-aligned summit
threads.summary: Defa Press and IRIB reported Pezeshkian held bilateral meetings with Putin, Aliyev of Azerbaijan and the Armenian PM at the non-aligned leaders' summit in Turkmenistan, telling Putin that 'American unilateralism is unacceptable.' Araghchi also held brief talks with the Azerbaijani and Russian foreign ministers ahead of the summit.

threads.label: Khamenei policing-week FARAJA messaging
threads.summary: Khamenei's office published a cascade of excerpts from the Supreme Leader's policing-week message praising FARAJA's role in 'the second and third imposed wars' and against the 'American-Zionist enemy.' Defa Press ran companion commentary from Sardar Kargar and the Tehran Friday imam.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz and shared-field posture
threads.summary: Tehran's Friday imam said the Strait of Hormuz 'will not open until Iran's seven conditions are fully met,' while Defa Press reported heavy explosions in the southern passage attributed to mines. Iran International reported Saudi Aramco hired a US firm to upgrade an offshore field shared with Iran.

threads.label: Gaza strikes and Lebanon incidents
threads.summary: The IDF announced strikes dismantling four Hamas and Islamic Jihad weapons facilities in Gaza and killing three operatives including a rocket-unit commander. Defa Press claimed five Israeli soldiers were killed or wounded in southern Lebanon, naming Major Eliav Haim Tsfelmous, and reported continued Israeli artillery and air strikes on southern Lebanese towns.

threads.label: UK Iran-linked surveillance case and influence op
threads.summary: Two men accused of conducting hostile surveillance on the Israeli Embassy in London, Britain's oldest synagogue and other Jewish sites on behalf of Iran pleaded not guilty. OpenAI reported an Iran-origin influence operation used fake Western journalist identities to place nearly 100 articles and generate hostile responses targeting Iran International.
